parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: Number of items per page in a paginated query. The maximum is 100, and the default is 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier list-supplier-registrations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --max-results 20 --next-token AAAAAYChudnQUoBH+mGWFpb6oP0= --filter '[{"Value":["sr-xxx"],"Name":"SupplierUid"}]' --region cn-hangzhou
